ai_summary: Ashoka Buildcon Limited announced the cancellation of a significant SAR 351.37 million (approximately Rs. 846.38 Crore) hotel construction project in Saudi Arabia, which was previously awarded in February 2026. This material event, attributed to the employer's internal reasons, represents a substantial loss of future revenue and negatively impacts the company's order book and financial projections. The immediate red flag is the abrupt project termination, with the company currently seeking detailed reasons and determining the next course of action.
